name: qr-scan-check
title: QR Scan Check
description: Post-scan check showing the real domain against what's printed beside the code (with a go-to-printed-site option), flagging lookalike and brand-borrowing domains, short links (via your resolver), app downloads, and for UPI codes the payee, amount and refund scams.

meta.stops: Helps catch a fake QR sticker before it opens
meta.summary: Shows where a scanned QR code really goes before anything opens, so a fake sticker over a real code doesn't send you somewhere else.
meta.server: Check URLs against a safe-browsing service and verify UPI payees on the server before payment.
catches: Destination that differs from the printed site (sticker over a real code)
Short links, followed through your resolver
UPI codes: payee, pre-filled amount and "scan to receive a refund" scams
limits: Doesn't scan the code itself; pass the decoded payload
Brand and shortener lists are defaults; pass trusted and shorteners
Can't tell whether a site you trust has been compromised
a11y: Result is a group labelled by its heading
Verdict is in a polite live region with text, icons aria-hidden
